claims: Reid Wiseman is the Artemis II Commander.
Reid Wiseman has stated he is "not a religious person".
Reid Wiseman returned from the moon in April 2026.
Reid Wiseman broke down in tears upon seeing a cross on a Navy chaplain’s collar.
Reid Wiseman requested to see the chaplain upon returning to the recovery ship in the Pacific Ocean.
Reid Wiseman explained to the chaplain, "I’m not really a religious person, but there was just no other avenue for me to explain anything or to experience anything".
Reid Wiseman explained the moment as a moment to process the "otherworldly" experience.
Victor Glover is a fellow crew member of Reid Wiseman.
Victor Glover is a religious Christian.
Reid Wiseman highlighted the difference in his perspective compared to Victor Glover.
Reid Wiseman noted that despite different beliefs, both he and Victor Glover were deeply affected by the experience.
A social media post suggested Reid Wiseman has Jewish heritage.
Primary source reports of Reid Wiseman's own words indicate he identifies as not religious.
